4613-6218-7014.easyPrerequisites:
Pheres-Band Tromper doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
North Pole Patrol is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
4613-6218-7014.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-6218-7014.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper using North Pole Patrol's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using North Pole Patrol's ability by tapping it, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

258-1409-5696-8203.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Jyoti.
258-1409-5696-8203.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
258-1409-5696-8203.description:
Activate Jyoti by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jyoti enters, it and Deadeye Navigator trigger.
Resolve the Jyoti trigger, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game
When the Forest Dryads enter, Tatyova triggers that many times, giving them haste until end of turn.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jyoti.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

529-4186-7297-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

5078-5223-6918-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2999-4050.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2999-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

2457-3000-5794-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3122-4089.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3122-4089.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Glasspool Mimic and Undercover Operative each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3122-4089.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

5902-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
5902-7009-7715.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Innkeeper's Talent.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

225-783-1170-7529.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Jungle Basin.
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {1}{G}. 
Cast the copy of Rampant Growth from exile by paying {1}{G}, unpreparing Studious First-Year.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Studious First-Year, which enters prepared.
Resolve Rampant Growth, fetching a basic land from your library to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

4613-5295-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
4613-5295-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-5295-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

1409-2933-5798-7297.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1409-2933-5798-7297.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2281-3817-5670.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token,.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

911-2438-6972--112.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Propeller Pioneer.
When Propeller Pioneer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Propeller Pioneer enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
911-2438-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Propeller Pioneer's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

3593-4050-6990.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Michelangelo from your hand to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Michelangelo, adding {R}.
When Michelangelo dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3661-3698-4053-6989.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
When Shield Sphere enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

1003-4053-5147-6989.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

628-6797-6935.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2510-6869-6884.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-6869-6884.description:
Cast Aang, Airbending Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Aang, Airbending Master enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, the Last Airbender
Cast Aang, the Last Airbender from exile by paying {0}.
When Aang, the Last Airbender enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, Airbending Master.
Cast Aang, Airbending Master from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2228-3108-3680.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Stunt Double.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Stunt Double by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

67-2034-2781.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reveillark.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-2577-4871.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional Zombie.
You control another Zombie.
2511-2577-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2511-2577-4871.notes: Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat this loop spending mana from Treasures instead of the creature tokens, giving you infinite creature tokens.

2457-4094-4289-4885.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2457-4094-4289-4885.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2653-3129-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
2653-3129-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
2653-3129-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa each trigger twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

372-673-3277.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Planar Incision exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Izzet Chronarch exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
372-673-3277.description:
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1140-1636-2692-3143.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1140-1636-2692-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1061-1576-2334.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} the first turn, with {3}{U}{U}{U} available each extra turn
1061-1576-2334.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
You have an effect that grants Timestream Navigator haste each turn.
1061-1576-2334.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder triggers, blinking Forerunner of the Coalition.
Forerunner of the Coalition enters, triggering its first ability, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1322-2440-2703.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

575-2034-3760.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Broodhatch Nantuko, adding {C}{C}.
When Broodhatch Nantuko dies, Yedora triggers, returning Broodhatch Nantuko from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Broodhatch Nantuko by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Broodhatch Nantuko's morph ability by paying {2}{G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1228-4221.notablePrerequisites: Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-4221.description:
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any land an opponent controls.
The land dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a land enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

171-1367-1827-5261.notablePrerequisites:
"Dragons" chosen with Palace Siege.
Your life total is at least three.
171-1367-1827-5261.description:
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to get an extra turn after this one and shuffle it into your library.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vampiric Tutor without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Vampiric Tutor, searching your library for Nexus of Fate, then shuffling your library and putting Nexus of Fate on top of it, and causing you to lose 2 life.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Palace Siege triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
At the beginning of your draw step, you will draw Nexus of Fate from the top of your library.
Repeat.

1308-2733-4050-5043.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Faerie tokens, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
